x: From a letter by Edgar Good - Life Member, recalling training during the period 1902-1914. "After a race or training spin you arrived back to a nice hot bath, prepared by our trainer, Bill Harland - that is if you were first home; after that it got thicker and thicker, probably the forerunner of the 'mud pack'.
